purpose: fit the spatial density of the hidden new-fault truth from the five public scores, then choose the emission set the fitted density prefers

equations: T_i = sum_k w_k A_ik,  G = sum_k w_k B_k
F_i = E_i - T_i  (one emitted pixel serves at most one truth pixel)
model.masking: catalogue pixels are charge-free (forum 11516, verbatim, fetched 2026-09-25) and are excluded from E

credit_denied_reading_B.meaning: if emitting on a catalogue pixel earns no credit either, only the off-catalogue part of a candidate counts; the ordering of the additions is unchanged, the level is lower

emitted_candidate.why_this_one: the catalogue pixels are the only addition that cannot lower the score under the platform's written masking rule, and the fit's point estimate for it (0.349) is the largest single move available
emitted_candidate.experiment: the score difference against 0.1563 measures which reading of forum 11516 the platform implements: no change = catalogue pixels earn no credit either; a jump = they do, and the whole emission plan changes
